blocking_issues.location_en: Section 'Japan is leaving the zero-rate era while carrying a very large public balance sheet', structural-indicator table; section 'The country is a major external creditor even when trade is not consistently in surplus'; IIP chart.
blocking_issues.location_pt_BR: Seção 'O Japão está deixando a era de juros zero carregando um balanço público muito grande', tabela de indicadores estruturais; seção 'O país é grande credor externo mesmo quando o comércio não está sempre em superávit'; gráfico da posição internacional de investimentos.
blocking_issues.issue: The table labels the end-2025 net international investment position of ¥561.750 trillion as the 'Latest reference' / 'Referência mais recente', and the external-balance section and chart use that year-end snapshot as the current structural anchor. Japan's Ministry of Finance has already published a preliminary end-March 2026 IIP: total assets ¥1,849.649 trillion, liabilities ¥1,289.533 trillion and net IIP ¥560.116 trillion. Because the external creditor balance is central to the dossier's thesis, presenting the older year-end value under an explicit latest-reference heading is a material temporal mismatch.
evidence: Japan Ministry of Finance, International Investment Position of Japan, end-March 2026 preliminary estimate: https://www.mof.go.jp/policy/international_policy/reference/iip/202606a.pdf
Japan Ministry of Finance, International Investment Position of Japan, end-2025: https://www.mof.go.jp/english/policy/international_policy/reference/iip/e2025.htm

required_fixes: Update the IIP evidence to the latest available end-March 2026 preliminary estimate in both EN and PT-BR, including the structural-indicator table and quantitative chart, while explicitly marking the observation preliminary; or, if end-2025 is intentionally retained for an annual comparison, remove the claim that it is the latest reference and explain why the older annual snapshot is analytically preferred. The current external-balance thesis must remain consistent with whichever reference is used.
Keep EN/PT-BR values, units, period/status labels and analytical interpretation semantically identical after the correction.
Preserve the country-context identity, related_research_ids and controlled taxonomy unless a separately evidenced correction is necessary.

country_context_contract.summary: The item is a v2 country-context country-dossier for Japan with country-level geography and four canonical related research IDs. Japan is materially involved in the referenced Global Macro corpus through BOJ normalization, yen/JGB transmission and energy-import exposure; the dossier adds reusable political, demographic, external-balance, energy and industrial context rather than a generic country profile.

taxonomy.summary: Primary program political-economy-markets, related programs, all three dimensions, Japan geography, topics, event-driven cadence and demographic-transition phenomenon are controlled and substantively supported.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Both editions open directly with the analytical thesis, use finding-led headings, avoid exposed QA/template fields, connect economics, politics and society through mechanisms, and remain readable as institutional research. PT-BR is substantially localized rather than mechanically translated.

contextual_depth.summary: The dossier connects parliamentary institutions and BOJ independence, demographic aging and labor scarcity, fiscal pressure, external creditor status, energy dependence after Fukushima and industrial-policy adaptation. Historical context is tied to current mechanisms rather than presented as chronology.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: The country-dossier visual floor is exceeded and EN/PT-BR visual structure is semantically parallel. However, the IIP chart reproduces the same stale-as-latest temporal choice that blocks the factual gate, so visual readiness cannot pass until the IIP reference/status is corrected consistently in both editions.

translation.summary: The reviewed EN and PT-BR editions preserve the same thesis, quantitative evidence and visual mechanisms. The IIP temporal correction must be applied symmetrically.

contrary_evidence: The Ministry of Finance preliminary end-March 2026 IIP shows net IIP of ¥560.116 trillion, slightly below the ¥561.750 trillion end-2025 value, while gross external assets and liabilities both increased. This does not overturn the large-net-creditor thesis but demonstrates that the older value is not the latest available observation.
limitations: Several structural energy indicators intentionally use FY2023 reference data; their older period is explicitly disclosed and they are not presented as current-month flows.
The September 18 BOJ rate decision is a same-day current-event observation and was cross-checked against contemporaneous reporting; future policy transmission remains inferential.
The geographic map is an analytical transmission map, not a bilateral-share dataset, and the text states that limitation.
notes: No approval was created. The public corpus remains authoritative; this country-context item must return with corrected current IIP temporality before publication.
